name: io.github.Marysbrain/x402-gateway-mcp
title: Aye Pulse + Scout
description: Independent x402 market intelligence plus two scoped pre-payment diligence tools on Base.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Buyer wallet key (fund with a few USDC on Base). Optional: free previews work without it.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call above this price. Default 0.25.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SESSION_USD
environmentVariables.description: Total spend cap per session. Default 2.00.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL override. Default https://pulse.aye.today.

environmentVariables.name: EXPECTED_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Pinned payment destination override for a controlled test deployment.

environmentVariables.name: EXPECTED_SIGNING_KID
environmentVariables.description: Pinned manifest signing key ID override for an audited gateway release.
